title: MySwimPro Session SWOLF Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=myswimpro:session swolf_score=*
| stats sum(swolf_score) as total_value, avg(swolf_score) as avg_value by drill_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks drill values by total and average swolf score across MySwimPro session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `swolf_score` values for each MySwimPro session event and review total and average swolf score by drill.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total swolf score.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which drill shows the biggest swolf score numbers in your MySwimPro session data.
